birdsong.speech.prompt: This world uses voice commands. Birdsong can listen for them and recognise your speech on this computer, so nothing you say is sent anywhere.
birdsong.speech.prompt.download: Turning it on downloads a speech model for your language once, usually 30 to 50 MB.
birdsong.speech.prompt.later.hover: Ask again the next time you join
birdsong.speech.prompt.never.hover: Don't listen and don't ask again. You can change this in the Birdsong settings.
birdsong.speech.disabled: Speech recognition is off. Turn it back on with /birdsong speech on.
birdsong.speech.later: Not now. Birdsong will ask again the next time you join.
birdsong.speech.ready.voicechat: Listening for voice commands through Simple Voice Chat. Talk as you normally would.
birdsong.speech.ready.push_to_talk: Listening for voice commands while you hold %s.
birdsong.speech.ready.open: Listening for voice commands whenever you speak.
birdsong.speech.no_key: Bind Push to Talk under Controls, Birdsong, or turn Push to Talk off in the Birdsong settings.
birdsong.speech.download.start: Looking for a speech model for your language...
birdsong.speech.download.failed: Couldn't download a speech model (%s). You can download one from %s and unpack it into %s.
birdsong.speech.silent: No audio reached Birdsong. Another program may be holding the microphone, so pick a different input device in the Birdsong settings.
birdsong.speech.no_server: This server doesn't have Birdsong, so voice commands can't run here.
birdsong.config.title: Birdsong
birdsong.config.speech.tooltip: Ask: offer to turn it on when you join a world with voice commands. On: always listen in worlds with voice commands. Off: never listen.
birdsong.config.source.tooltip: Auto uses Simple Voice Chat when it is installed and the microphone otherwise. Through Simple Voice Chat, only what you transmit is heard.
birdsong.config.push_to_talk.tooltip: Microphone only. On: listen while the Push to Talk key is held. Off: listen whenever you speak.
birdsong.config.instant.tooltip: On: fire as soon as a command is recognised. Off: wait until you finish the sentence, which is a little more accurate.
birdsong.config.echo.tooltip: Print every recognised sentence into chat and the log. Use it to find out why a command isn't matching.
birdsong.config.input_device.tooltip: Part of the recording device's name. The usable names are listed in the log when the microphone opens.
birdsong.config.model.tooltip: The name of a model folder in birdsong/models, or a full path to one. Leave it empty to pick the model that matches your game language.
